description.mn: Acqua di Parma Blu Mediterraneo Cipresso di Toscana: Хүйс харгалзахгүй модлог үнэр (Cologne). Эхний ноот: розмарин, базилик, мэргэн өвс, бэрсүүт жүрж, петигрейн; зүрхний ноот: нарс, лаванда, кориандр, кардамон, жасмин, хонхон цэцэг; суурь ноот: кипарис, нарс, ветивер, хуш мод, царсны хөвд, пачули.
description.en: Acqua di Parma Blu Mediterraneo - Cipresso di Toscana by Acqua di Parma is a Woody Aromatic fragrance for women and men. Acqua di Parma Blu Mediterraneo - Cipresso di Toscana was launched in 2005. The nose behind this fragrance is Bertrand Duchaufour. Top notes are Rosemary, Basil, Sage, Grapefruit and Petitgrain; middle notes are Pine Tree, Lavender, Coriander, Cardamom, Jasmine and Lily-of-the-Valley; base notes are Cypress, Silver Pine, Vetiver, Cedar, Oakmoss and Patchouli.
